messages:
michael: Quick ping — opened PR #4587 to add streaming tool-call support to the Python + JS clients. Can someone take a look today? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4587. TL;DR: support stream_tools=True, stream multipart chunks from runtime, add README example + e2e. Aiming to merge in the 18:00 UTC window if no major objections. cc @anya @samir @eva :eyes:

anya: Thanks — I'll review the Python changes in the next hour. Any known regressions?

michael: No functional regressions expected; integration tests cover toolcall flow. Noticed one flaky e2e timeout locally, but I think it's unrelated to stream handling. CI is currently queued.

samir: I'll take the JS client side. Is the streaming interface backwards-compatible for existing clients that rely on non-streaming toolcall?

michael: Yes — default behavior unchanged. We expose an opt-in param `stream_tools` (defaults to false). Also added a small adapter so older SDKs see the same message schema when not streaming.

eva: Quick question: what are the retry semantics on partial chunk failures? If a connection drops mid-stream do we fall back to non-streaming or return an error? Need to document for customers.

michael: Good point — current plan: connection drop => stream abort + error to client. We didn't add automatic fallback because reconciling partial tool outputs is tricky. I can add a note to the README and a server-side flag later if product wants fallback.

ci-bot: CI status: build/PR-4587 — unit-tests: passed, e2e: failed (test_timeout_toolcall_stream) — flaky. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/4587/logs

anya: The failing e2e looks like a timing race in the test harness. I can patch the test to wait for final chunk. Will open small fix PR against the same branch unless someone objects.

samir: No objections. I'll start reviewing the JS changes; leaving :eyes: here. If I run into API mismatch I'll post inline.

michael: Thanks both. If CI stabilizes we should be able to merge in the 18:00 UTC merge window. If either of you have blocking feedback, flag it here — otherwise I'll merge after approvals and green CI.

eva: Also, could we add a short note in the console changelog about the new stream_tools flag and the lack of fallback? PMs asked to be informed.

michael: Will do — adding entry to the changelog and pinging the PM channel after merge.

anya: small nit in python client: prefer `stream_tools: bool = False` in signature (explicit typing). Posting inline.

samir: left a comment about chunk-parsing edge case in JS parser. Not blocking.

ci-bot: CI status update: build/PR-4587 — e2e: flaky re-run queued (retry #1).

michael: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll wait for two approvals then merge during the window.

anya: Approving now. :white_check_mark:

samir: Approving after quick second pass. :shipit:
